# axm skills

Manage agent skill extensions.

## When to use

Use this command family when creating, installing, publishing, or reconciling skills.

## Usage

```bash
axm skills <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](./global-flags).

## Examples

**Add a code review skill to your agents**

```bash
axm skills install @acme/skills/code-review
```

**Pin to a specific version range**

```bash
axm skills install @acme/skills/code-review@^1.0.0
```

**Install from a GitHub repository**

```bash
axm skills install owner/repo
```

**See what skills are installed**

```bash
axm skills list
```

**Bump a skill version**

```bash
axm skills version @acme/skills/code-review patch
```

## Subcommands

| Command                                       | Summary                                                                                                  |
| --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [axm skills install](#axm-skills-install)     | Reinstall configured skills from their sources, or install skills from a registry, GitHub, or local path |
| [axm skills uninstall](#axm-skills-uninstall) | Uninstall a skill from agents                                                                            |
| [axm skills list](#axm-skills-list)           | List installed skills                                                                                    |
| [axm skills update](#axm-skills-update)       | Update installed skills to latest versions                                                               |
| [axm skills new](#axm-skills-new)             | Create a new skill                                                                                       |
| [axm skills enable](#axm-skills-enable)       | Enable a previously disabled skill                                                                       |
| [axm skills disable](#axm-skills-disable)     | Disable a skill without uninstalling it                                                                  |
| [axm skills version](#axm-skills-version)     | Bump a managed skill manifest version                                                                    |
| [axm skills publish](#axm-skills-publish)     | Publish extensions to a registry                                                                         |
| [axm skills prune](#axm-skills-prune)         | Remove unmanaged skill artifacts from the workspace                                                      |

### axm skills install

Reinstall configured skills from their sources, or install skills from a registry, GitHub, or local path

```bash
axm skills install [flags] [<source>]
```

### axm skills uninstall

Uninstall a skill from agents

```bash
axm skills uninstall [flags] <skill>
```

### axm skills list

List installed skills

```bash
axm skills list [flags]
```

### axm skills update

Update installed skills to latest versions

```bash
axm skills update [flags] [<source>]
```

### axm skills new

Create a new skill

```bash
axm skills new [flags] <name>
```

### axm skills enable

Enable a previously disabled skill

```bash
axm skills enable [flags] <name>
```

### axm skills disable

Disable a skill without uninstalling it

```bash
axm skills disable [flags] <name>
```

### axm skills version

Bump a managed skill manifest version

```bash
axm skills version [flags] <handle> <bump> [<version>]
```

### axm skills publish

Publish extensions to a registry

```bash
axm skills publish [flags] <extensions...>
```

### axm skills prune

Remove unmanaged skill artifacts from the workspace

```bash
axm skills prune [flags] <patterns...>
```

## Requirements

- workspace

## Side effects

None.
